name: Baptiste David
biography: is a computer science engineer who has been working for the CVO laboratory for many years. His research areas are based on operational and offensive computer security for protection of critical systems. He is specialized n reverse engineering, kernel development and malware analysis. He has especially worked on GostCrypt and many antivirus project for many years. He made numerous conferences all over the world about security and offensive techniques.
